faqs.q: What is the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve and what does it do?
faqs.a: The Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve is a pilot-operated, 2-position poppet valve: the solenoid opens a small pilot, and system pressure moves the main poppet, so a small coil switches a large flow. A reverse free-flow check lets oil pass the other way when it is closed. Poppet seating gives very low leakage — under 10 drops a minute at 5,000 psi. It is rated 15 gpm to 120 gpm (60 L/min to 480 L/min) at up to 5000 psi (350 bar).

faqs.q: How do I read the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve model code and its option letters?
faqs.a: DFCA/DFEA/DFFA are the base model in series 1, 3, 4. The letters after it choose the control (X — No Manual Override; D — Twist/Lock (Dual) Manual Override; L — Twist/Lock (Detent) Manual Override), the spool or poppet configuration (C — Normally Closed; H — Normally Open), the seal (N — Buna-N; V — Viton; E — EPDM) and the coil. For example DFCAXCN. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

faqs.q: What flow, series and cavity does the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve have?
faqs.a: This listing covers 3 versions: DFCA is series 1, T-13A, 15 gpm (60 L/min); DFEA is series 3, T-16A, 60 gpm (240 L/min); DFFA is series 4, T-18A, 120 gpm (480 L/min). A larger series carries more flow, so choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop.

faqs.q: How is the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve configured, and what should I check before choosing it?
faqs.a: For the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve, the configuration letter chooses the function: C — Normally Closed, H — Normally Open. Normally open or normally closed, chosen in the code. The solenoid tube is fatigue-rated for 5,000 psi (350 bar).

faqs.q: What pressure, leakage and response ratings does the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve have?
faqs.a: The DFCA is rated to a maximum operating pressure of 5000 psi (350 bar). Maximum leakage is 10 drops/min.@5000 psi (0,7 cc/min.@350 bar). Typical response time is 30 ms. Switching frequency is 15,000 max. cycles/hr. Check cracking pressure is 50 psi (3,5 bar). Pressure and flow are limited by the lowest-rated part of your circuit.

faqs.q: What seal materials and coil voltages does the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve offer?
faqs.a: For the DFCA, the seal material options are N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM. Coil: 19 coil choices, or no coil — 12 VDC, 14 VDC, 24 VDC, 28 VDC, 115 VAC, 230 VAC; connections include DIN 43650-Form A, Metri-Pack, Deutsch DT04-2P, Explosion Proof. Fitting a different external seal does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built.

faqs.q: Which cavity does the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve fit?
faqs.a: The Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve fits Sun's T-series cavity T-13A, T-16A, T-18A. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in the same series shares that cavity, and the seal kits for that series fit it.

faqs.q: Does the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve come with a coil, and what do I need to run it?
faqs.a: The coil is chosen with its own code, voltage and connector, and can be supplied fitted or ordered separately for the DFCA. Tell us the voltage and the connector your machine uses and we confirm the coil with the quotation. The range offers 19 coil choices.

faqs.q: What torque and seal kits apply to the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve?
faqs.a: Screw the DFCA into its cavity with a 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. Replacement seal kits: series 1: Buna: 990310007, Viton: 990310006; series 3: Buna: 990016007, EPDM: 990016014, Viton: 990016006; series 4: Buna: 990018007, Viton: 990018006. Only the external seals can be serviced.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun DFCA/DFEA/DFFA 2-way 2-stage solenoid-operated poppet valve used?
faqs.a: The DFCA is used for: load holding and high-flow on/off functions — lowering valves, accumulator isolation, unloading. The armature runs wet in the working fluid, so on long duty cycles check the fluid temperature limit.
